title: Web: Training
description: GET /api/coach/training?day=YYYY-MM-DD (default today), as of that day (features/web_training.py): the strength trend, every lift with its status and a short series, the lifts that don't count apart, and the recent runs and other sessions.

top_set.description: A session's heaviest working set in the rep range. Bodyweight lifts: effective_load_kg = bodyweight + added load (- assistance); load_kg is what Hevy logged.

status.description: Of the lift's latest session that wasn't ignored. stall: a counting lift with training.stall_sessions sessions in a row without progress (wins over same/declining). new_baseline: its first session or the first after a baseline reset. not_judged: see not_judged_reason. not_recent: not trained within training.lift_recency_days.

series.description: The small chart: estimated 1RM of the heaviest working set per session, oldest first, the last 12 sessions since the latest baseline reset.

activities.description: Runs and other sessions of the last 28 days up to the day, newest first: Strava runs, wrestling (planned, done or skipped), extra sessions, and planned sessions reported done that no Hevy session covers. Hevy lifting sessions are the lifts.

status.description: planned: a planned session that counts without a report (wrestling); the page shows it like a done one.

kcal_counted.description: What the session adds to the day's target (runs after the run discount). Null when the activity setup values aren't set yet.
